spec_match.rationale: The page animates path-length itself between visitor-chosen numeric endpoints with both transition and @keyframes, samples getComputedStyle('path-length') live, shows the spec'd dash and textPath consequences, and probes the 'by computed value' rule's discrete none↔number edge exactly as the SVG 2 propdef in w3c/svgwg#1073 defines.

interactive.rationale: Endpoint sliders, the transition trigger, the keyframes play/pause toggle, and the none→1000 probe all drive real property changes with per-frame sampled readouts and a timestamped sample log.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index card promises animating the property itself with visitor-controlled endpoints, live computed values, and the discrete none edge — the page delivers each element.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers unsupported browsers (labelled simulated-attribute fallback with exact flag steps), the keyword none↔number discrete-flip probe (which honestly refuses to simulate when unsupported), and asymmetric endpoint choices via the sliders.

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus feature 4861677550043136 and the spec PR w3c/svgwg#1073 whose propdef (animation type: by computed value) the page demonstrates.

conformance.rationale: The existing immutable feature-level conformance.json (css-supports and computed-roundtrip assertions) covers this page's probed surface; per the immutability rule it was not modified.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via Playwright CDP exercised every control on desktop and mobile with screenshots read and console clean except the environmental fonts failure — but Chromium 141 predates the feature (the SvgPathLengthCssProperty flag does not exist in this build, verified by launching with it), so only the labelled fallback branch could execute; the native interpolation branch is untested pending a Chrome 150 environment.

telemetry_health.rationale: The primary actions report via window.showcaseTelemetry?.assert with distinct ids for native success (path-length-interpolation-native, requiring observed intermediate computed values) and the fallback branches (path-length-interpolation-fallback, path-length-keyframes-fallback, path-length-none-discrete-unsupported), so a fallback can never masquerade as a native pass.

design_system.rationale: All colors come from the shared CSS variables, toggle buttons pair background and color in the aria-pressed=true override, and the page follows the sibling concepts' shell (crumbs, lede-block, stage, readout).

accessibility.rationale: Endpoint sliders have for/id-associated visible labels, all three stateful buttons expose aria-pressed (verified flipping), result/playback readouts are role=status while the per-frame ticker is aria-hidden to avoid announcement spam, SVGs carry aria-labels, and controls are native buttons/inputs with visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 1280×800 mouse/keyboard and 360×740 DPR3 touch: zero horizontal page overflow (long code chips break via overflow-wrap, the code block scrolls in its own pre container), buttons are min-height 44px, and the transition ran to completion by tap on mobile with the same honest readout.

openQuestions.title: Verify the native interpolation branch on Chrome 150
openQuestions.detail: This sandbox's Chromium 141 predates the feature and its SvgPathLengthCssProperty flag, so the native path (getComputedStyle sampling during a real CSS transition/keyframes of path-length, and the discrete none→number flip) has only been code-reviewed, not executed. Once a Chrome 150/Canary environment with chrome-devtools-mcp is available, run the transition, keyframes, and none probes there and confirm the sampled values and the path-length-interpolation-native telemetry assertion.

openQuestions.title: Sample marker/motion-path consequences
openQuestions.detail: The spec also lists motion animation among the surfaces path-length affects. A follow-up panel (or new concept) could show an animateMotion / offset-path traveller whose distance mapping changes as path-length animates.

guidanceConsulted.query: animate CSS custom property numeric interpolation live readout controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Numeric CSS values interpolate smoothly while keyword values (like intrinsic-size keywords) only animate when a rule makes them interpolable — treat keyword↔number animation as discrete unless the spec says otherwise.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied as the page's core teaching: numeric path-length endpoints interpolate ('by computed value'), and the none↔number panel demonstrates and asserts the discrete flip instead of pretending it interpolates.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible toggle button pressed state and announcing dynamic status updates politely
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-pressed for toggles, associate visible labels via for/id, and announce results through restrained status regions without spamming rapidly-changing values.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All three action buttons manage aria-pressed; sliders use <label for>; end-of-run results and playback state are role=status while the per-frame computed-value ticker is aria-hidden with its final value mirrored into the status line.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider with visible label and live value readout responsive layout
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep native range inputs and theme them with accent-color rather than building custom sliders.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Endpoint controls are native <input type=range> with accent-color: var(--accent-blue) and width min(320px, 100%) so they never overflow the mobile viewport.

summary: New concept built to close the corpus's only open MAJOR question: it animates the path-length property itself (transition: path-length 1500ms and @keyframes from {path-length: var(--pl-a)} to {path-length: var(--pl-b)}) between slider-chosen endpoints, samples getComputedStyle per frame into a ticker and timestamped log, and shows the dash re-scaling plus a textPath sliding along its wave — with a separate probe for the spec's discrete none↔number rule. In this sandbox (headless Chromium 141 via Playwright CDP; chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable; flag verified absent) the page honestly reports non-support with exact SvgPathLengthCssProperty enable steps and runs a clearly-labelled simulated attribute fallback, never claiming native interpolation: verified transition run 800→1600 logged 8 samples all marked '(simulated attribute)', keyframes ticker oscillated while playing, and the none probe refused to simulate. Desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 both screenshot-verified with zero horizontal overflow; console clean except the environmental fonts.googleapis.com failure.
